name: Ladhak Kargil trip
route: Early morning departure for Kargil → Early morning departure for Leh → Leh → Chang La Pass
description: Embark on an extraordinary journey from the lush valleys of Kashmir to the rugged high-altitude landscapes of Ladakh. This 8-day itinerary offers a seamless blend of scenic beauty, cultural exploration, and adventurous road trips. From the serene Dal Lake in Srinagar to the dramatic terrains of Kargil, Leh, Nubra Valley, and Pangong Lake, this tour is thoughtfully designed to provide a complete Himalayan experience.
highlights: Explore Mughal Gardens and enjoy a Shikara ride on Dal Lake
Drive through the scenic Sonmarg and Zoji La Pass
Visit Drass, one of the coldest inhabited places in the world
Discover ancient monasteries like Lamayuru, Hemis, and Thiksey
Experience Magnetic Hill and Gurudwara Patthar Sahib
Cross Khardung La Pass to reach Nubra Valley
Explore Hunder Sand Dunes and enjoy camel safari (optional)
Travel via Chang La Pass, one of the highest motorable roads
Route Srinagar → Kargil → Leh → Nubra Valley → Pangong Lake → Leh

itinerary.title: Arrival at Srinagar Airport and transfer to hotel/Houseboat
itinerary.desc: Upon arrival at the airport, pick up & Drive to the reserved hotel. Later visit local sightseeing’s like Nishat & Shalimar Garden, in the evening enjoy the beautiful sunset at Dal Lake Shikara Ride at Dal Lake. Overnight stay in Hotel / Houseboat

itinerary.title: Early morning departure for Kargil
itinerary.desc: After early breakfast leave for Kargil, via Sonamarg & Zojila pass (3,528 m). Since you are driving across Zojila Pass and its route’s uncertainty, you need to reach Sonamarg early in the morning. Reach Drass Village (2nd Coldest Inhabitant place in the World) by lunch time on the way visit War memorial hall & Museum, reach Kargil by evening loc Kargil Hunderman Boader View Point. Distance 215-220 km approx Check in at hotel in Kargil

itinerary.title: Early morning departure for Leh
itinerary.desc: After breakfast departure to Leh on the way visit Mulbekh chamba (Buddha Sculpture on Rock Mountain), Lamayuru (oldest Monastery of Ladakh), Moonland view, Sangam of Sindhu and Zanskar rivers (from view point), Magnetic Hill, Patthar sahib Gurudwara. In evening Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, Market. Distance km approx Overnight at Leh

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: After early breakfast, you will set off for Thiksay monastery. Its looks like Potala palace of Tibet, Enroute visit Druk Pama Karpo (Rancho School) Shey Palace. Hemis Monastery (the largest & richest monasteries in Ladakh). In the evening you can visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace (build in 17th century by King Singay Namgyal) after stroll around the market place for some last day souvenir shopping. Distance 40-50 km approx Overnight in Hotel at Leh

itinerary.title: Drive across Khardung La Pass And Reach Nubra Valley (Valley of Flowers)
itinerary.desc: After breakfast drive towards to Nubra Valley, driving across Khardong-la (Second Highest Motor able Road in the World alt: 5602Mts/18390Ft). After descending from the pass, Nubra Valley is popularly known as Ldorma or the valley of flowers. It is situated to the north of Ladakh between the Karakoram and Ladakh ranges of the Himalayas. Arrive at Hunder & check in at Hotel/Camps. Later visit Diskit Village & the Sand Dunes where you can enjoy a short camel safari using the double-humped Bactrian camel found here (optional on direct payment). Distance 120-130 km approx Overnight in Hotel/Camp in Nubra Hunder

itinerary.title: Scenic drive along Shyok River And Reach Pangong Lake and explore surroundings
itinerary.desc: (Note: Route subject to weather conditions; alternate plan may apply.) After breakfast, leave for Pangong Lake via Shayok. Along the route, enjoy the scenic views of Shayok River & Karakoram Range. This route has few water crossings mainly in the month of June & July, to avoid these you need to leave early from Nubra. Reach Pangong Lake by afternoon. The lake is world highest saltwater lake situated at an elevation of 4,225 m. extending to almost 130 km long, 1/3 of its lies in India and 2/3 in China).. NOTE: THIS ROUTE DEPENDS ON WEATHER CONDITIONS. IF ROUTE BLOCK OCCURS REACH BACK TO Leh & STAY OVERNIGH. NEXT DAY Pangong LAKE VISIT WILL BE ONE DAY TRIP. Distance 150-160 km approx. Check in at Camp/hotel in Pangong

itinerary.title: Return journey via Chang La Pass
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, leave for Leh across another one of the highest motorable roads in the world, Chang La Pass at an elevation of 5360 M –. Enroute visiting Shey Palace, Thiksey Monastery.. Rest & later have a leisure evening in the Leh market. Distance 140-150 km approx. Reach Leh by afternoon/evening, check in at Hotel Leh

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: After breakfast. Our teams thank you for your patronage and ensure a punctual drop to Airport to catch the flight for your onward Destination. TOUR ENDS BUT SWEET MEMORIES ALWAYS REMAINS

inclusions: 3 Nights stay in Leh with breakfast & dinner
1 Night stay in Nubra Valley with meals
1 Night stay in Pangong with meals
1 Night stay in Kargil with meals
1 Night stay in Srinagar with meals
Parking, toll taxes, and fuel charges
exclusions: Adventure activities (rafting, camel safari, ATV, etc.)
Extra costs due to delays, weather, or roadblocks
essentialTips: Use postpaid SIM cards for better connectivity in Ladakh
Pack warm clothes including thermals and jackets
Stay hydrated and allow time for acclimatization
Start early for long travel routes
